Regles.title: The rules
Regles.intro: Predict which biathletes will perform, play their odds, and try to grab the Yellow Bib as the season's best predictor.
Regles.baremeHint: Odds × multiplier based on finishing rank. Nothing beyond 10th place.
Regles.s_principe_body: For each individual race, pick 3 biathletes. The riskier your pick (higher odds), the more it can pay off — but it must finish in the Top 10. Combination bonuses: Podium (+100), Top 5 (+50), Top 10 (+20), and a Perfect Pick if you find the 3 highest-scoring biathletes (+200).
Regles.s_grillage_body: A biathlete you pick becomes unavailable for the next race of the same stage. They become available again at the next stage (unless you use the Meltdown card).
Regles.s_cotes_body: Each biathlete has odds per format (sprint/pursuit/individual/mass start), re-evaluated at key points in the season. Pursuit odds are recalculated automatically after the sprint: +5 per 20s of gap (first bracket neutral), capped at 40.
Regles.s_relais_body: You predict a nation instead of 3 biathletes. Only the top 5 nations score, on a reduced scale compared to individual races.
Regles.s_globes_body: Before the season starts: overall winner, best young athlete, and best nation, for both men and women. The overall globe rewards precision on the final Top 5 the most.
Regles.s_bonusx2_body: 3 uses per season, on a World Cup individual race or relay (not on World Champs/Olympics or special races). Doubles every point from that prediction.
Regles.s_mondiaux_body: Every race at these events counts double automatically, not stackable with the personal ×2 bonus.
Regles.s_special_body: Penalty loop: -20 pts per penalty loop by your biathletes. Fog: outside the Top 10, a malus equal to the finishing position. Busted: a malus if one or more of your 3 picks finish outside the Top 10 (up to -300), and -200 if you don't predict at all.
Regles.s_streak_body: 10 consecutive races scoring points (relays included) earn you a bonus card of your choice: 4th pick (4 biathletes, best 3 count, over 2 men's and 2 women's races, relays excluded) or Boost (×3 on one biathlete in an individual race, never ×6 with a ×2). Only one card active at a time.
Regles.s_pepite_body: A bet placed at the start of the season on an outsider per sex (odds ≥ 30). A hidden pick: on their first Top 10 of the season, their race score is added as a bonus, then they become a regular athlete again.
Regles.s_fuseegachette_body: Rocket (sprint and individual only): +50 pts if one of your picks had the race's best ski time (once). Trigger (pursuit and mass start only): +20 pts per pick with a perfect 20/20 at the range (stackable).
Regles.s_classement_body: Adds up every point scored over the season. The leader wears the Yellow Bib. Secondary standings (Red Bib) and private leagues between friends also exist.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Biathlonpronos ("the Application") respects its users' privacy. This privacy policy explains what personal data is collected, how it is used, and what your rights are.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
paragraphs: When you use the Application, we collect:
bullets: Predictions, bonus cards and game history
Sign-in data (email and password, or OAuth provider: Google, Apple, Facebook)
sections.note: We do not collect any bank or payment data: the game is entirely free.

sections.title: 3. Use of data
paragraphs: The data collected is used exclusively to:
bullets: Provide the game features (predictions, standings, globes, leagues)

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
paragraphs: Your personal data is never sold or rented to third parties.
Some data may be processed by our technical providers (hosting, database, authentication) strictly to run the service.

sections.title: 5. Third-party sign-in (OAuth)
paragraphs: The application offers sign-in with Google, Apple and Facebook. These sign-ins are subject to those providers' privacy policies, and we never receive your password. If you sign in by email, your password is stored encrypted by our authentication provider: we never have access to it in plain text.

sections.title: 6. Data retention
paragraphs: Your data is kept as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, your personal data is deleted within 30 days.

sections.title: 7. Your rights (GDPR)
paragraphs: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the following rights:
bullets: Right of access to your personal data
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")

sections.title: 8. Security
paragraphs: We implement reasonable technical and organisational security measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or disclosure.

RuleInfo.title: How does it work?
RuleInfo.individual: Pick 3 biathletes. Each one scores if they finish in the Top 10: their odds × 25 for a win, × 18 for 2nd place… down to × 1 for 10th. Bonus if your 3 picks all finish in the Top 3, Top 5 or Top 10.
RuleInfo.fusee: Rocket bonus: +50 pts if one of your biathletes has the fastest ski time.
RuleInfo.gachette: Trigger bonus: +20 pts per biathlete who shoots 20/20.
RuleInfo.pursuitStart: Athletes start in the order of the sprint results, and odds are re-evaluated based on the time gap.
RuleInfo.grilled: Biathletes picked for the previous race of the stage are burned: you can't pick them again.
RuleInfo.relay: For relays, pick a single team: it scores if it finishes in the Top 5 (its odds × 10 for a win, then × 6, × 4, × 2 and × 1).
RuleInfo.x2: Until the start, you can change your prediction and activate a ×2 bonus (3 per season).
